test_coverage: Existing language modules have 6-17 test functions each. Test dimensions include: query compilation, element extraction (classes, functions, methods, interfaces, traits, enums), call extraction, import extraction, inheritance extraction (superclass and interfaces), defuse query (write sites, read sites, assignments), function name extraction, receiver type extraction, method lookup. approaches.name: Full PHP Integration with All Handlers
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY (functions, methods, classes, interfaces, traits, enums), CALL_QUERY (method calls), REFERENCE_QUERY (type references), IMPORT_QUERY (use statements), DEFUSE_QUERY (variable declarations, assignments, reads), plus extract_function_name, extract_inheritance handlers. Register in mod.rs, lang.rs, Cargo.toml. Add 12+ tests covering all dimensions.
pros: Complete language support matching Java/Kotlin/Swift patterns
Enables all analysis features: inheritance tracking, defuse analysis, method lookup
Consistent with project's comprehensive language coverage
cons: Requires understanding of PHP grammar inheritance patterns

approaches.name: Minimal PHP Integration (Element + Call Queries Only)
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY and CALL_QUERY only. No DEFUSE_QUERY, no inheritance extraction. Register in mod.rs, lang.rs, Cargo.toml. Add 4-5 tests for query compilation and basic extraction.
pros: Covers basic symbol discovery use case
cons: Incomplete compared to other major languages

approaches.name: PHP with DEFUSE_QUERY but No Inheritance
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY (variable declarations, assignments, reads). Include extract_function_name handler. Omit inheritance extraction. Register in mod.rs, lang.rs, Cargo.toml. Add 8-10 tests.
pros: Enables defuse analysis for variable tracking
Covers most common analysis use cases

recommendation: Approach 1 (Full PHP Integration with All Handlers). The issue explicitly asks to 'model after Java integration', which includes ELEMENT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, and extract_inheritance. Full integration ensures PHP receives parity with other major languages (Java, Kotlin, Swift) and enables comprehensive code analysis. The medium complexity is justified by the project's commitment to consistent, feature-complete language support.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
element_query_draft:
pub const ELEMENT_QUERY: &str = r"
(function_definition
  name: (name) @function_name) @function
(method_declaration
  name: (name) @method_name) @function
(class_declaration
  name: (name) @class_name) @class
(interface_declaration
  name: (name) @interface_name) @class
(trait_declaration
  name: (name) @trait_name) @class
(enum_declaration
  name: (name) @enum_name) @class
";
defuse_query_draft:
pub const DEFUSE_QUERY: &str = r"
(simple_parameter
  name: (variable_name (name)) @write.param)
(assignment_expression
  left: (variable_name (name)) @write.assign)
(foreach_statement
  value: (variable_name (name)) @write.foreach)
(variable_name (name)) @read.usage
";
inheritance_walk_citation: In tree-sitter-php grammar (common/define-grammar.js), class_declaration has optional base_clause and class_interface_clause as child nodes (not fields). To extract inheritance: (1) iterate child nodes of class_declaration, (2) find children with kind 'base_clause' and extract their name children (extends), (3) find children with kind 'class_interface_clause' and extract their name children (implements). Each name node contains the inherited class/interface identifier. This differs from Java's superclass/interfaces fields; PHP uses optional sibling nodes.
